text:
Living Wyverns
​
Introduction
Wyverns are one of the 4 raptor mobs, and are known for their unique environmental effects and highly damaging attacks. They offer decent  XP, and are a consistent source of GP due to their wyvern bone drops.
​
⬥ The Dragon slayer perk and sigil  , along with any other dragon-slaying related items such as , do NOT work on wyverns.
​
Stats
⬥  XP per kill : 1878.8
⬥ Optimal kills per hour: ~700  /  (ALL AFK)
⬥ Optimal  XP per hour : ~1.3M  /  (ALL AFK)
​
Use this tile for all styles.

​
Desirable Drops
⬥ Wyverns have a rich drop table with a guaranteed drop of Wyvern bones, a valuable item and an ingredient for super prayer potions.
⬥ For the Slayer collection log, Wyverns are also killed for their unique drop, the Wyvern Crossbow , a T85 crossbow dropped at a rate of 1/2000 on task (1/10,000 off-task).
​
Location and How to Get There
Living Wyverns are found in 2 locations:

The Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, accessed via a rope in the south of the Skeletal Wyvern room.

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. The easiest way to get there would be via dungeoneering cape teleport  to the Frost dragon dungeon (0,8)

Northwest of Ghorrock, accessed via the Ghorrock teleport (ancient spellbook)

‎ ‎ ‎ ‎a. This is the best location as it benefits from the  and 
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎b. Wyverns are also attackable from areas without the chill mechanic, making it viable to be stationary and AFK in this location.
​
Mechanics



















Wyrm breath
⬥ Wyverns have a breath attack different from that of dragons, and requires wyrmfire protection.
    • Use wyrmfire potions or elder overload salves to block all damage from this attack.
​
Cavern chill
⬥ Wyverns reside in a habitat which slowly increases the player's cold percentage.
    • The higher the chill percentage, the lower the poison damage taken by the player. No poison damage will be taken by players with ~70% chill.
    • At ≥25% chill, wyvern attack damage increases to 2500 from around 1300.
    • At ≥90% chill, players will be periodically stunned at 8-10s per stun, Never let your chill reach this stage.
    • Fires throughout the wyvern habitats and be lit, standing within 2 tiles of them periodically lowers the player's chill percentage.
    • This mechanic is avoided completely by standing outside of area affected by cavern chill in the wilderness.
​
Wyrm poison
⬥ Wyverns can inflict poison damage based on the percentage of Cavern chill every 4-5 ticks.
    • Antipoison++ halves the damage, but every tick of poison decreases potion duration.
    • This mechanic is avoided completely by standing outside of area affected by cavern chill in the wilderness.
​
Varied attacking
⬥ Wyverns can attack with all 3 styles, alongside their breath attack.
    • They will attack with primarily  if the player stands in melee range.
    • Hence, either stand in melee distance and use  or camp  and out heal their damage through high DPS.








Useful Items



















Items
⬥ Elder overload salve 
    • By far the best potion to use here due to its wyrmfire protection.
⬥ Upgraded bonecrusher 
    • Useful for gathering wyvern bones, in combination with Death Note 
⬥Underworld Grimoire 2/3/4 
    • Very useful for sending wyvern bones to storage as soon as they're dropped.
Passive unlocks
⬥ Stone of Jas buff 
    • Provides a 5% damage increase against living wyverns in the wilderness.
⬥ Infernal Puzzle box 
    • Provides a 9% damage increase and 14% damage reduction in the wilderness at max rank.

⬥ Upkeep , , , , , and  at all times.
⬥ Use Totem of Vitality  and Boon of Het HP boosts.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required if using  and Legendary pet.
⬥ Use  to help aggro the Living Wyverns.
​

⬥ Use Totem of Vitality  and Boon of Het HP boosts.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required if using  and Legendary pet.
⬥ Use  to help aggro the Living Wyverns.
​
Preset
⬥ Active/AFK Magic 

​
Active Strategy
⬥ If doing them actively with best-in-slot gear, stand close to the most north-western fire in the wilderness spot (refer to example vod), and use target cycle to target wyverns within range. Use  whenever  is used along with  if available.
​
⬥ Use  combos opportunistically on any wyverns that wander close to each other.
​
⬥ When eating solid food, such as sharks dropped by wyverns, try to eat them in the tick between the end of a kill and the start of the next kill when you have no target, as this does not reduce adrenaline.
​
⬥ If doing wyverns with lesser gear, an  may be used to aggro a limited amount (2-3) of wyverns which makes it more manageable to , as shown here
